exposure: Time period (before label revision, after label revision but before guideline update, after guideline update)
cohort: 13,797 women with hypertensive disorders before childbirth who delivered in Japan between January 2005 and April 2020.
finding: While there were significant changes in antihypertensive prescription trends after label and guideline revisions (increased nifedipine, decreased hydralazine), there were no significant changes in pregnancy outcomes.
